audit_risk_model.interpretation: Normalized research-demo indices, not calibrated probabilities and not an audit opinion.
audit_risk_model.input_policy: Only executed/declared evidence may create a positive or negative signal. Missing evidence creates a coverage gap, not a PASS.

financial_reporting_complexity.basis: Large diversified reporting footprint; bounded POC

disclosure_complexity.basis: Bounded risk-factor sample has low readability

market_business_pressure.basis: FY2026 simple price return -24.2%; not itself audit evidence

icfr_opinion_signal.basis: Unqualified ICFR opinion lowers but does not eliminate control risk

control_level_evidence_gap.basis: Current POC lacks full control-by-control operating effectiveness evidence

itgc_evidence_gap.basis: Dedicated ITGC/cyber control evidence package not yet executed

procedure_coverage_gap.basis: CAM procedures mapped, but full engagement procedure population not available

evidence_sufficiency_gap.basis: Evidence Passport exists; several specialist modules remain pending

human_review_gap.basis: Human Gate exists; production approval remains NO

poc_result.boundary: Illustrative, uncalibrated normalized research-demo indices; not probabilities, not audit conclusions.
